node.statement: By the registered definition def-lefschetz-fixed-point-data, at the nondegenerate fixed point 0 of T the local fixed-point index is J(T,0)=sgn det(I-DT_0). Since DT_0=A, this is J(A,0)=sgn det(I-A), agreeing with the local Brouwer-degree computation in node 1.3.2.
